mapper.select: SELECT order_state AS orderState, COUNT(*) AS count FROM spu_order WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} and del_flag = 0 GROUP BY order_state ORDER BY order_state ASC
SELECT order_state AS orderState, COUNT(*) AS count FROM spu_order WHERE user_id = #{accountId} and del_flag = 0 GROUP BY order_state ORDER BY order_state ASC

select t.spu_id, t.spu_order_no, sum(t1.buy_num) as order_count, sum(t1.refunding_quantity) as refunding_count, sum(t1.refunded_quantity) as refunded_count, sum(t1.delivery_quantity) as deliver_count, t.goods_snapshot, t.freight_amount from spu_order t left join sku_order t1 on t.spu_order_no = t1.spu_order_no where t.order_no = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.del_flag = 0 group by t.id
SELECT order_state AS orderState, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM spu_order ${ew.customSqlSegment} GROUP BY order_state
